user_saw: A Telegram progress card could appear below the bot’s final answer if the message tool sent the answer while the run was still active.
summary: The fix notifies channels as soon as a final message-tool send succeeds in message-tool-only mode, so they can retire the progress card while the run continues.
reasoning: PR #154467 wired Telegram’s progress cleanup to `onObservedReplyDelivery`, which the runner already called during post-run finalization, leaving a window for later progress events. PR #162756 added the send-time delivery flag and PR #175837 moved it into the session controller without changing that timing. Telegram’s progress rendering predates the shallow boundary, and the available offline history did not establish when this specific failure first became possible or show that it previously worked.
